hints.content:
The inequality $-3>x$  is read as $-3$ is greater than $x$.  

So, $x$ must be less than $-3$.
So, we need to graph all values that are less than $-3$.

question.content:
**Choose the graph of the inequality  $-3>x$.**

[[☃ radio 1]]
